classes.name: ExternalActionAuthorizationLifecycleModule
classes.description: Chisei-owned module that resolves external-action policy snapshots, applies approval and cancellation transitions, reclaims expired authority, releases reservations, and records durable audit projections.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces namespace and project access preflight, translates protocol values, and delegates external-action lifecycle behavior to Chisei modules.

classes.name: ExternalActionAuthorization
classes.description: Durable state-machine record binding an external-action request, policy snapshot, decision, approval status, reservation state, deciding actor, and lifecycle timestamps.

relations.name: delegates_external_action_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates policy snapshotting, lifecycle transitions, expiry cleanup, reservation release, and audit projection to the external-action authorization lifecycle module.

relations.name: governs_external_action_authorization
relations.description: The external-action authorization lifecycle module creates and transitions durable external-action authorization records.
